title: FIIs sold ₹2.41L Cr all year — then bought ₹54K Cr in 10 days #Shorts
description:
₹2.41 lakh crore sold all year. ₹53,739 crore bought back in just 10 days. Something just changed in Indian markets.

Foreign portfolio investors recorded their highest-ever annual outflow from Indian equities in 2026 — ₹2.41 lakh crore. Then in the first 10 trading days of November, FIIs turned net buyers and pumped ₹53,739 crore back in.

What changed: global AI trade unwinding, crude falling toward $91, India's valuations looking cheap vs global peers. Nifty up 10.85% from its Oct 29 low.

Sources: BusinessToday, Business Standard (Nov 10-11, 2026). Educational content only.
